# Interface: BaseResult

Defined in: [src/core/result/result.ts:34](https://github.com/jterrazz/package-test/blob/main/src/core/result/result.ts#L34)

Base result - common accessors available after any action type.
Extended by HttpResult, CliResult, and used directly by job results.

Every result carries a fresh [CaptureScope](CaptureScope.md): `match.ref()` captures
and `{{type#ref}}` placeholders are scoped to one spec execution.
